Malphite

Mid Pure meme

AP Malphite Mid

How to play this build

Poke with Seismic Shard (Q) from range and farm safely with Ground Slam. Your moment is the ult (Unstoppable Force): Flash+R onto the carry and detonate DFG + Rabadon to one-shot it. A meme build, but lethal.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Fragmento Sísmico → E Golpe de Tierra → W Palmada de Trueno

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Seismic Shard (Q) for AP poke and the move-speed steal; unlike tank Malphite who maxes E (armor). E second.

Items and what they do

  1. Rabadon's Deathcap The biggest AP item in the game: multiplies your total AP.
  2. Deathfire Grasp The classic burst item: AP + active that deals % target-health damage and amplifies your next hit. One-shots.
  3. Rylai's Crystal Scepter AP and health; your spells slow enemies (helps land everything).
  4. Zhonya's Hourglass AP and armor; stasis active makes you invulnerable and untargetable for a couple seconds.
  5. Sorcerer's Shoes Boots with magic penetration.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/0/9 — Offense
Why this page
21/0/9 goes full AP so the ult one-shots.
Runes
Magic pen, armor, AP quints
